name: Zakuro no Koto
source:
Akoya, the eldest son of a wealthy family Watanuki, and his younger sister, Zakuro. For some reason, they live in a small house far away from the mansion, just the two of them. Akoya is a painter who dedicated his life to paint the pure Zakuro. Zakuro admires her brother who paints about her, and loves him with from the bottom of her heart.

However, Zakuro has a secret she cannot tell to Akoya......

[Translated from [url=https://succulent01.wixsite.com/zakurono]the official website[/url]]
translation:
富家渡贯的长子阿古也和妹妹扎九郎。不知为何，他们住在远离宅邸的一栋小房子里，只有他们两个人。阿古屋是一位毕生致力于描绘纯洁的扎克罗的画家。扎九郎很欣赏为自己画画的哥哥，并且从心底里爱着他。

然而，扎九郎有一个不能告诉阿科亚的秘密……

[翻译自[url=https://succulent01.wixsite.com/zakurono]官网[/url]]
